title: CourtGuard: A Model-Agnostic Framework for Zero-Shot Policy Adaptation in LLM Safety
reasoning: The paper introduces a framework for evaluating LLM safety by grounding evaluations in policy documents that include ethical principles and hazard taxonomies. It utilizes and audits several safety benchmarks (e.g., PKU-SafeRLHF, JailJudge) that are explicitly designed to measure a model's adherence to ethical and moral standards of safety and harm prevention.
